ownership.quote: Today we're excited to announce that Butter is joining Modal! Butter founder Erik Dunteman and researcher Raymond Tana will be joining the Modal Sandbox team as part of the acquisition.

stage.quote: Today we're excited to announce that Butter is joining Modal!
stage.note: Butter (YC W25) was acquired/acqui-hired by Modal, announced 2026-04-10; no pre-acquisition priced funding round was found in public sources, so the prior independent-company stage (likely pre-seed/seed given it was a fresh YC batch company) could not be confirmed. Classified as subsidiary reflecting its current status as part of Modal.

note: Butter (YC W25, 'Embedded Sandboxes for Agents', building bVisor) was acquired by Modal, announced 2026-04-10 ('Butter is joining Modal'); founder Erik Dunteman (previously cofounder of Banana.dev) and researcher Raymond Tana joined Modal's Sandbox team. The YC founder bio itself states 'Founder and CEO at Butter.dev (acquired by Modal 2026)'. No funding amounts, investors, or revenue were disclosed publicly for Butter prior to the acquisition. bVisor is described by its own README as an early proof-of-concept, local in-process syscall-interception runtime, not production-ready hosted compute.
